item.title: Never Lose a Reader: Versions and Translations
item.dc:creator: Luis Majano
item.description: Two of the fastest ways to lose a documentation reader: they land on docs for the wrong version of your software, or they land on a page in a language they don't read well and there's no obvious way out. BX Sites handles both the same way it handles most things - a folder convention, no config flag to remember to flip.
